OAuth2 compatible form data login endpoint for Swagger UI Authorize dialog.
Accepts application/x-www-form-urlencoded credentials (username = email, password).
Returns RFC 6749 compliant {"access_token": "...", "token_type": "bearer"}.
Applies the same Argon2id verification, brute-force lockout, rate limiting, and audit logging as /login.

Rotate refresh token. Invalidates presented refresh token and issues a new one in the same family.
Replay of a revoked refresh token triggers reuse detection and revokes the whole family.
Log out of current session and revoke refresh token family.
Increment token_version to invalidate all active JWTs and refresh sessions across all devices.

Evidence view router enforcing the Three Views & Four Unlocks.
- SKELETON: Keypoints on black, bounding boxes, HUD. (Always accessible, only tier for auditors).
- BLURRED: Every face blurred. Accessible if org default is blurred, or via breakglass or emergency context.
- RAW (TARGETED): Authorized emergency reveal unblurs ONLY flagged track IDs with watermark.
- RAW (FULL): Approved identity reveal unblurs all faces with watermark.

post.description:
Public, anonymous student emergency SOS report.
- Resolves zone and organization from sos_token (404 on invalid token).
- Honeypot check against bot abuse (400 on detection).
- Rate-limited per IP (3 requests per minute; 4th request returns 429).
- Zero personal retention: No IP or device identifier stored beyond sliding window.
- Emits Signal (modality='report', kind='student_sos', score=0.9) directly to FusionEngine.
- Fusion rule: SOS alone -> high severity; SOS + audio/video in same zone -> critical severity.
- Tamper-evident audit logged anonymously.

get.description:
Returns a zone x hour-of-day (0-23, org timezone) grid.
Each cell contains:
- incident_count, confirmed, false_alarms, pending
- risk_score = sum(severity_weight * review_weight)
  severity_weight: critical=4, high=3, medium=2, low=1
  review_weight: confirmed=1.0, investigating/new=0.6, false_alarm=0.1
Includes per-zone totals and per-hour totals.

Ranks zones by expected risk for the shift's hours:
- Baseline: sum of review-weighted risk_score over shift hours in past N days
- Boosts:
  + Open incidents pending investigation (+3.0 per open incident)
  + Camera tamper in last 48h (+2.5)
  + Student SOS in last 48h (+3.0)
Returns ordered patrol recommendations with peak hour, reason text, and suggested check time.

Summary metrics:
- Totals by severity (critical, high, medium, low)
- False-alarm rate (false_alarms / total_incidents)
- Average time to acknowledge (seconds)
- Average time to review (seconds)
- Top incident kinds
- Status breakdown
